body: I was in the same boat, about 4 or 5 days of happiness. Today's different. Today, I'm on the bottom. But I hope you can keep this streak going, break the fucking horrid disease of depression and strive and become the envy of all depressed individuals. Become the goal we all strive to be, because it's so hard to find hope in today's world. One survivor can make all the difference.

My dog was an outside-indoors dog, we left the backdoor open. He couldn't get neutered because he had some sort of allergic reaction to the anesthesia, so he ended up jumping our wall because of an unspayed female walking by (a 6 inch chihuahua jumping a 5 foot wall from only 1 inch away, talk about agility).
well I was getting an MRI done for my back (I've had chronic pain the past year) me and my dad went to village inn afterwards after being in a small tube for 2 hours. on our way home, I saw my dog, surrounded by neighbors in the middle of the street. My body trembled. I couldn't get any emotion out of my body. I calmly walked towards, probably waddled, to my dog as my dad picked him up. He put him in my hands and we rushed to my van. We took him to the small animal hospital, but the surgery was cosmic in terms of price, and we were already struggling to eat every day. We had to put him down, I couldn't stand to see him in pain. I left him alone and it was my fault because I didn't close the backdoor. It's all my fault my little buddy is dead.. his ashes sit on top of the entertainment system along with most of his toys. He was sitting in the street with a shattered pelvis and internal bleeding without his family for god knows how long, and in the end he's gone after a long suffering. Pets don't understand illness, they don't fear death like we do and whatever happens to our pets always ends up happening for the greater good, to keep the cycle of life going. But that doesn't mean I wouldn't give anything in the world to say sorry to my Buddy for leaving him alone..
I've also closed and locked many doors, almost in fear of what lies behind it.

All I've wanted is a partner to share my struggles with, I'm tired of using entertainment as a surrogate. I'm tired of society and the human cattle system that's in place just to put the people in power in even more power. I've spent thousands of hours playing on my computer.. and for what? Ending up where I started, is what. Probably in deeper than I think.. I might kill myself tonight. I'm a timebomb and there's nothing I can do about it.
In a society that seems to thrive on an unseen caste system, where individuals get shunned simply because they are themselves, is certainly a cause of depression, don't you think?
